meta.what: Baseline arena checkers measured on this machine on the big corpora, the way the Lean Kernel Arena measures (perf stat -e instructions:u over the whole process tree, GNU time max RSS). The ranking metric is virtual_time_s = instructions / 6e9 on mathlib.

host.note: the arena runner is x86-64, 8 vCPU, 16 GB; absolute counts differ, see aarch64_over_x86_64

meta.container: bench/arena-docker.sh --arena-limits --no-network (8 performance cores, 16 GB, one run per container); a run made otherwise says so in its own "container" field
meta.measure: bench/measure.sh (perf stat --no-scale -e instructions:u summed over PMUs, task-clock, duration_time; GNU time %M)
meta.representative_value: median over the runs of the arena configuration; *_min/_max/_spread_pct next to it
meta.timeout: 2 x the arena's timeout of the corpus (init 370 s, std 600 s, mathlib 4120 s)
meta.caveat: wall and CPU times were taken while other containers shared the host (and at times the same 8 cores); instruction counts do not depend on that

mathgraph.note: accepts 8 bad proofs on the small tests; not a ranking competitor
